# 南華真經直音--賈善翔

**ID:** KR5c0132
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0125

## Authors / Editors
- 賈善翔

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Zhí yīn* is a **minor but useful reading aid** for the *Zhuāngzǐ*. It complements Chén Jǐngyuán's ([陳景元](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E6%99%AF%E5%85%83)) more comprehensive *Yīn yì* ([KR5c0129](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0129), DZ 736, 1084) in the same decade, indicating an active Northern-Sòng engagement with the *Zhuāngzǐ*'s philological challenges.

**Dating.** Preface 1086. Per the project's dating rule, the frontmatter gives **1086** as the composition date. Dynasty: 宋.

**Author.** Jiǎ Shànxiáng 賈善翔 was a Northern-Sòng Daoist scholar, author of several works preserved in the Daozang, including ***Yóu lóng zhuàn*** 猶龍傳 (DZ 774, a Lǎozǐ hagiography) and *Gāo dào zhuàn* 高道傳 (fragments preserved in DZ 783). He was active in the Yuán fēng 元豐 (1078–1085) and Yuán yòu 元祐 (1086–1094) eras.
